checks.name: primary_key_unique::(invoice_no,stock_code,order_date,customer_id)
checks.sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT "invoice_no", "stock_code", "order_date", "customer_id", count(*) AS c
                FROM "dbt_schema"."fct_sales"
                GROUP BY "invoice_no", "stock_code", "order_date", "customer_id"
                HAVING count(*) > 1
            ) dup
